meta.name: paid-ads
meta.description: Coordinate safe, evidence-based paid-media work across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, Amazon, and ChatGPT Ads. Use for broad ads questions, multi-channel strategy, budgets, CPA or ROAS, campaign requests, spend, ad performance, or when routing to the right NotFair paid-ads skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统筹多渠道付费广告预算与策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在 Google、Meta 等多个平台管理付费广告
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate paid media across major ad platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid ads across multiple platforms

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会先确认转化目标、预算等关键信息,再将请求转给Google、Meta等专项技能;信息缺失时会把建议标为草稿,并给出可衡量、可回退的投放决策。
howto.when: 当用户提出宽泛的广告问题、多渠道策略、预算或CPA/ROAS等需求,或要求查看投放表现时触发。

say.text: 帮我看一下这周的广告投放表现,该砍哪笔预算?
say.note: 会先要转化、预算等信息,再给建议。

say.text: 我想在 Google 和 Meta 同时投新品,怎么做预算分配?
say.note: 会先确认目标与跟踪,再给可回退的计划。

say.text: 我的 CPA 太高,应该怎么调?
say.note: 会先查转化价值与阈值,再给调整建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first confirm key inputs such as conversion goal, budget, tracking status, and missing inputs are labeled as drafts. It then routes the request to the appropriate specialized skill (e.g., Google, Meta) and ends with a measurable, reversible recommendation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks broad ad questions, multi-channel strategy, budgets, CPA/ROAS, campaign requests, spend, ad performance, or needs routing to the right paid-ads skill.

say_en.text: Can you review this week's ad performance and tell me which budget to cut?
say_en.note: It will ask for conversion and budget info first.

say_en.text: How should I split the budget for launching a new product on Google and Meta?
say_en.note: It will confirm goals and tracking, then give a reversible plan.

say_en.text: My CPA is too high. What should I change?
say_en.note: It will check conversion value and thresholds first.
